actions.extract_file_data.description: Upload a file and immediately receive extracted content
actions.extract_file_data.props.checkbox: Whether to recognize checkboxes and their states
actions.extract_file_data.props.fields.d: Define the data fields you want to extract from documents
actions.extract_file_data.props.file.des: The file to upload for extraction. Supported: PDF, images (JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP), Word docs (DOC, DOCX), text files (TXT)
actions.extract_file_data.props.hasVisua: Whether the document contains charts, graphs, or diagrams
actions.extract_file_data.props.language: Document's language for accurate extraction. Extracta.ai supports multiple languages with advanced AI algorithms designed to parse linguistic nuances.
actions.extract_file_data.props.longDocu: Enable for very large or complex documents
actions.extract_file_data.props.name.des: A descriptive name for the extraction
actions.extract_file_data.props.pageFrom: Starting page number (required if Specific Page Processing is enabled)
actions.extract_file_data.props.pageTo.d: Ending page number (required if Specific Page Processing is enabled)
actions.extract_file_data.props.specific: Extract only a specified range of pages
actions.extract_file_data.props.splitPdf: Treat each PDF page as a separate extraction unit
actions.get_extraction_results.descripti: Fetches successful data from extraction. Note: The API recommends a 2-second delay between requests to avoid rate-limiting.
actions.get_extraction_results.props.fil: The ID of the file (optional). If provided, filters results to only that file.
actions.upload_file.props.batchId.descri: The ID of the batch to add files to (optional). If not provided, a new batch will be created.
actions.upload_file.props.file.descripti: Document file to upload (PDF, images, etc.)
description: An AI document extraction & content analysis platform that transforms unstructured files (PDFs, images, URLs, etc.) into structured data.
triggers.extraction_failed.description: Triggers when a document extraction fails.
triggers.extraction_failed.props.webhook:
To use this trigger, you need to manually set up a single webhook endpoint in your Extracta.ai account. This endpoint will receive all events, and Activepieces will filter for the correct one.

1.  **Login** to your Extracta.ai dashboard.
2.  Navigate to the **API** section from the side menu.
3.  Scroll down to **Webhook Settings**.
4.  Click **"Create a new webhook"** (or edit an existing one).
5.  Paste the following URL into the **Endpoint URL** field:
    ```text
    {{webhookUrl}}
    ```
6.  Click **Save**.

This single webhook will now send all events to Activepieces. This trigger will only activate for the **'extraction.failed'** event.
